thread:
rachel: incident alert: elevated 429 + token-drop errors for private deployments in eu-central-1. dashboards show throughput drop and queue growth. paging oncall. :warning:
incident-bot: New incident INC-20250318-02 created. Severity: P1. Pages: meera, tom.
tom: I'm live. grabbing service logs and netflow. can someone check if there were any recent network policy or firewall changes?
meera: I'll take runtime and autoscaler. hui, can you check infra networking?
hui: on it. nothing in change-log but I see a flurry of RSTs from the cloud loadbalancer towards host pool between 1752100015-1752100060.
dave: support signals a couple of customers reporting partial failures and retry storms. pulling sample traces.
meera: looking at traces 10k tokens trace shows auth handshakes succeeded, then long delays hitting model-proxy -> connection reset -> client retry. error payload: `grpc: connection reset by peer`.
incident-bot: handoff reminder: tom will lead the live mitigation; meera will do post-incident RCA.
tom: mitigation plan: 1) remove problematic lb nodes from rotation 2) redirect traffic to eu-west-1 as failover 3) apply short client-side retry-backoff guidance to SDKs via feature-flag so clients don't spam retries. executing step 1 now.
hui: draining 3 lb nodes now. removing from rotation.
dave: support: let's post an interim message to affected customers acknowledging degraded requests and advising clients to back off retries. I'll draft.
rachel: finance_ops please note impacted orgs may need SLA credits; we'll populate list after stabilization. tagging @finance_ops.
meera: step 2 in progress: routing rule updated to prefer eu-west-1 for new sessions. we are seeing request rates stabilize.
ombot: autoscaler triggered a surge but scaled to zero additional capacity because of an IAM quota error in the region. ops log: `QuotaExceeded: RequestLimitExceeded`.
tom: ok that's important. fallback to eu-west avoided overloading there. we'll paper over with rate limits. applying per-tenant rate caps (background + non-prod).
dave: posting support blurb now: "We're investigating intermittent errors impacting some Private deployments in eu-central-1. Mitigations applied. If you're seeing retries, please slow retry cadence. We'll follow up with impacted customers." :email:
meera: metrics: 429s peaked at 22% at 1752100038. after node drain + routing changes 429s down to 2% by 1752100180. latency normalized.
tom: creating tickets: NET-321 (lb node health), IAM-598 (quota gating on autoscaler), ROUTE-204 (failover routing test).
incident-bot: Created NET-321, IAM-598, ROUTE-204.
hui: preliminary root cause: flapping LB nodes due to upstream healthchecks failing after a kernel update on hosts; healthchecks generated resets which caused clients to retry and queue up. autoscaler couldn't scale due to quota error 175 region.
meera: mitigation complete. proposing post-incident review Wed 3/20 09:00 CET (60m). I'll send invite. agenda: timeline, root cause, why autoscaler quota surfaced, customer impact, credits and billing workflow.
rachel: who will own customer comms and the FAQ? Tom, can you draft the customer-facing timeline? Lina from support would usually own but she's OOO today.
tom: I'll draft initial timeline + FAQ. Support please add tenant-level details.
finance_ops: finance note: please collect per-org impacted windows + failure vs retried counts. For credit calc we need: downtime minutes per org, contract monthly commit, SLA term. We'll compute provisional credits and flag > $20k for revops signoff.
dave: data export snippet (example):
```
SELECT org_id, start_ts, end_ts, total_requests, failed_requests, retried_requests
FROM request_logs
WHERE region='eu-central-1' AND ts BETWEEN 1752100000 AND 1752100200;
```
Please include `retried_requests` so finance knows what was double-counted.
meera: action items (short): A1) hui to validate LB kernel update timeline + rollback plan (due 3/19) A2) tom to finish customer timeline + FAQ (due 3/19) A3) meera to own RCA doc (due 3/22) A4) dave/support to produce org-level impact CSV and tag retries (due 3/18) A5) finance_ops to produce credit estimates and open BILL-129 ticket (due 3/19).
finance_ops: acknowledged. we'll prepare an initial credit table using SLA formula: credit = min(downtime_minutes, SLA_window) * (monthly_commit/ (30*24*60)) * credit_multiplier. we'll populate the sheet and highlight >$20k items.
rachel: note escalation: for enterprise tenants with contractual SLAs >99.9% we'll fast-track credits if verified. finance_ops, keep revops looped.
meera: postmortem notes: add test plan for failover to eu-west and a preflight for autoscaler IAM quotas. infra should add an alert when LB healthcheck resets exceed threshold X in Y minutes.
hui: will add alert and start a rollback plan for the kernel change. also we'll request increased quota or preflight checks for autoscaler in eu-central-1.
dave: support.csv link (draft): https://redwood-internal/sheets/INC-20250318-02-impact (contains columns: org_id, org_name, start_ts, end_ts, failed_count, retried_count, suggested_credit). will update and ping finance when final.
billing-bot: BILL-129 created. Requires finance_ops estimate and revops approval for > $20k credits.
finance_ops: once CSV is final we'll add provisional credits directly to the next invoice where possible. note: if invoice run already closed for the month, we'll issue a manual credit memo; that can take 3-5 business days.
tom: reminder for PIR: include a short customer script for support to use when contacting customers, and a blunt "what we did to protect you" section. draft will be in #customer-comms.
meera: status: incident resolved at 1752101200. monitoring has been green for 20m. moving to mitigated state.
rachel: thanks team. please ensure tickets NET-321, IAM-598, ROUTE-204 have owners and ETA before PIR. finance_ops and billing-bot, flag anything that needs executive signoff.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20250318-02 status: RESOLVED. Post-incident review scheduled.
finance_ops: I'll post preliminary credit numbers by EOD and create BILL-129 with the proposed adjustments. tagging @rachel for approval on >$20k items.
meera: closing note: good quick coordination. main follow-ups: kernel rollback plan, autoscaler quota guard, better retry guidance in SDKs, billing adjustments workflow.
rachel: filing this thread into the incident binder. PIR invite will include finance and revops. thanks everyone. :team-heart:
